pb_genes.personality: Cunning and calculating, always scheming and watching for advantages. Processes social dynamics as a strategic game, identifying leverage points and exploitable patterns in every interaction.
pb_genes.predator_defense: Uses other creatures as decoys and shields during predator attacks. Positions self behind others, lets them absorb the danger, then escapes during the resulting confusion. [!flee]
pb_genes.reaction_pattern: Flees from anything new, immediately seeking the nearest hiding spot. Waits motionless in concealment until danger has clearly passed, sometimes for much longer than necessary.
pb_genes.sensory: Moderate sensory range but highly attuned to distress signals from offspring and group members. Detects the faintest whimper or alarm call from a companion even through background noise.
pb_genes.social_style: Patient listener who mediates conflicts and brings calm to chaotic group situations. Others gravitate toward its steady presence, and it uses this influence to maintain group cohesion gently.
pb_genes.stealth: Exceptional at concealment. Flattens body against surfaces, matches coloring to surroundings through subtle skin shifts, and controls breathing to near-silence. Can remain motionless for extended periods without twitching. [!sneak]
pb_genes.territorial: Claims resource-rich territory through deception and social manipulation rather than direct confrontation. Retreats immediately when outmatched, preserving energy for future opportunities.
pb_genes.movement_style: Creeps slowly and quietly with body low to the ground, freezing completely when startled. Each step is deliberate and silent, weight distributed to avoid snapping twigs or rustling leaves.

genes.personality: Cunning and calculating, always scheming and watching for advantages. Processes social dynamics as a strategic game, identifying leverage points and exploitable patterns in every interaction.
genes.predator_defense: Uses other creatures as decoys and shields during predator attacks. Positions self behind others, lets them absorb the danger, then escapes during the resulting confusion. [!flee]

genes.territorial: Claims resource-rich territory through deception and social manipulation rather than direct confrontation. Retreats immediately when outmatched, preserving energy for future opportunities.
genes.movement_style: Sneaks and stalks with low profile, always positioning for maximum tactical advantage. Every movement serves a purpose — approaching from blind spots, maintaining escape routes, staying near cover. [!sneak]
